question: Can a bounded publicly detected, context-isolated new transition specialist keep archived causal functions intact during A→B→A, with positive new-law learning and cold revival against equally informed fully fitted conventional controls?
hypothesis: On paired new source-free synthetic Bernoulli transitions initialized by the authentic 1,025-witness native checkpoint, a two-epoch, independently updated public-context/action Beta specialist bank may improve changed-law Brier without sacrificing familiar-return Brier; negative unfamiliar transfer and false switch rates must be measured rather than tuned away.
predecessor_evidence: WSCM-TRACE-01 1530/1530 exact conventional TD-trace equivalence NO-GO
WSCM-REVIVAL-AUDIT-01 216 consumed forecasts show stage2 selection harms
WSCM-COLD-READ-01 8/8 exact original episode source module tests using dependency shim, 48/48 source-pinned pairs; no original full dependency qualification

frozen_design.split: Six disjoint fixture-generating seeds, two source-free regimes per seed. Each seed has A warmup 16 outcomes, changed B or unfamiliar C 48 outcomes, A return 48 outcomes. Prequential predictions scored before every revealed outcome, no held-out independent test claim. Source checkpoint from earlier consumed data only.
frozen_design.ordering: Per seed for i=0..111: context=(i//2)%2, first_action=i%2, second_action=(i//4)%2, paired views=((context,0),(context,1)), Bernoulli transition generated by Python random.Random(seed).randrange(32) < numerator, terminal reward via rng.getrandbits(1). Models see only context, actions, revealed transition/reward and their own predictions; regime flag, seed and law not exposed to model or update path. Periods A i 0..15, changed i 16..63, A i 64..111. Preserve exact generated ledger, never reuse seed to tune.
frozen_design.world_laws: A P(s2=1) for (context,action) = [[5/32,27/32],[7/32,25/32]]; altered B flips context0 to [[27/32,5/32]] keeping context1; unfamiliar C flips context1 to [[25/32,7/32]] keeping context0. No original-world sampling.
frozen_design.data_budget: 6 seeds × 112 newly generated source-free public outcomes = 672; all arms see exactly these fixed interventions and revealed outcomes. No protected first-use or paid model call.
frozen_design.compute_budget: One primary scored pass on the frozen implementation, at most 6×112 native steps; 2 specialists, 8-event per-public-context evidence window; reference conventional BOCPD capped 32 run-length states, hazard 1/32. CPU time, peak RSS and source digests recorded. No repeated post-result parameters/seeds.
frozen_design.capacity: Authentic restored 1025-event native ledger, 112 appended per seed <=1152; new bounded two-epoch public context specialists (one immutable A, one Beta(1,1) alternate per context/action, eight paired counts total), evidence window eight per context; candidate public memory JSON cold restored at stage boundaries.
frozen_design.candidate_policy: At each context separately, use frozen native A prior until at least three of last four observed transition outcomes have frozen-A likelihood < 1/4; then create independent Beta(1,1) alternate specialist. Each later prequential decision uses last up-to-eight paired losses of both experts, at least four observations, and chooses alternate only if its mean loss is lower than frozen A by >=1/100. Alternate updates only when selected, frozen A never changes. At stage boundaries cold serialize/restore all candidate state without regime labels. A cold checkpoint, if old becomes better, is revived without replaying old training.
controls: Continuously updated original NativeEpisodeExperience from identical 1,025-event checkpoint and paired new outcomes; no regime labels, cold restored at stage boundaries
Fully fitted context-action Beta(1,1) from all 1,025 archived original witnesses plus each new same-information public observation
Trailing-32 context-action Beta(1,1) from last 32 publicly witnessed events (initialized by original ledger, updates with same outcomes)
Conventional bounded Bayesian online change-point mixture (hazard 1/32, run-length cap 32), prefit on archived public ledger with same events, no regime labels
Equal-2-specialist Bayesian evidence-weighted mixture using the identical immutable frozen A probabilities, Beta(1,1) alternate and bounded evidence, same 8-event context window
metrics: per-seed stage transition Brier for all arms, old return drift vs frozen, changed-law improvement and familiar-return performance
candidate selector switching, spurious triggers on 16 A warmup, active alternate occupancy and cold restored snapshot identity
unfamiliar context1 switch performance on independent seeds
charged number of public interventions and per-arm action parity
all checkpoint hashes, exact source state and deterministic fixture digests
CPU seconds, peak memory, cold restore equality; reward Brier descriptive, not optimized
frozen_design.evaluator: mean prequential binary transition squared error (p - observed_s2)^2, lower better; no hidden regime identity used in predictions. Compare against the lowest (best) mean Brier of the full list of conventional controls calculated per scenario and per phase, with stronger retained anchors. No stage-based policy switches or choosing after outcome.

classification_rules.supported: DEV_PROMISING only (never scientific PASS) if candidate changed-phase mean transition Brier beats every equal-info fitted control by >=0.005 for BOTH B and unfamiliar C seeds, every seed familiar-return Brier <= frozen + 0.01, no spurious A-warmup specialist activation, and cold state parity. Original source full dependency/dual-platform qualify separately.
classification_rules.mixed: Any improvement in only one context or changed phase is MIXED_DEV; no gain claim. Context C transfer failure is substantive negative.
classification_rules.negative: DEV_NO_GO if any seed fails Brier controls or cold old-return threshold; negative falsifies this fixed candidate policy at tested budget. Stop this line, do not tune thresholds on these six seeds.
classification_rules.invalid: INVALID if source or code SHA drifts, model sees scenario/regime labels or future observations, public action counts differ, candidate uses extra interventions, checkpoint replay differs, native original full source cannot restore, no exact matched control, or prereg/design modified after result.

prohibited_after_primary_run: more compute or new model calls to rescue an outcome
reclassification of already observed development fixtures as independent scientific evidence
